behavior.admission: One record per registry entry, including internal and deprecated skills; missing registry yields no records. Present malformed envelopes, entries, identities, duplicate identities and referenced unavailable templates raise explicit errors.
behavior.metadata: Exact raw registry entry, including all eleven current schema fields, unknown extensions, nested values, null, empty collections, ordered arrays and absence distinctions. No defaults inserted.
behavior.provenance: Registry source_path and /skills/index locator; template path normalized under snapshot root and SHA-256 computed from raw template bytes.
behavior.separate_authority: Template frontmatter and registry mappings remain independent, including different names, descriptions, portable/internal flags and workflow references. Optional display description fallback does not manufacture registry metadata.
behavior.legacy_compatibility: All 42 current skills retained. allowed-tools remains string or list as authored; build-single-ticket and ac-tree-split retain its absence, and ac-tree-split keeps tools, trigger and visibility verbatim.
behavior.boundaries: Relative paths are confined after resolution, rejecting absolute, Windows-drive, UNC and escaping traversal paths. Only registry and declared templates are read. Source instructions, workflows, dependencies and configuration references are never executed or resolved.
